Card Q&A.a: This is a special rule for this card that treats it as a card that has the [Numemon] name. This is a rule and not an effect, therefore this card is treated as having the [Numemon] name when the card is in your hand, breeding area, or any other area.
Card Q&A.q: What does this card's "(Rule) Name: Also treated as [Numemon]" mean, exactly?
Can this card be selected as the target of an effect that targets exactly [Numemon] due to the text "(Rule) Name: Also treated as [Numemon]"?

Effect: [On Play] [On Deletion] By trashing 1 card with [Numemon] or [Sukamon] in its name in your hand, 1 of your opponent's Digimon gains ＜Security A. -1＞ until the end of their turn.
Inherited Effect: [When Attacking] 1 of your opponent's Digimon gains ＜Security A. -1＞ until the end of their turn.
